cohort: The study included 306 pregnancies with placenta previa totalis delivered between January 2011 and June 2022.
finding: The study successfully developed and validated a LASSO-Logistic regression model, incorporating preoperative serum fibrinogen level, history of prior cesarean delivery, and history of antepartum bleeding, which demonstrated good performance (ROC AUC 0.706-0.721) in predicting PPH in women with placenta previa totalis.
mod_finding: History of prior cesarean delivery was identified as a significant predictor for postpartum hemorrhage.
